sources.evidence: CIMAF's current Gabon page identifies its operational grinding plant in the Owendo industrial zone, commissioned on 14 August 2015 and expanded to 1.85 million tonnes/year capacity.
The same official page lists current products including CEM III/A 42.5 N LH, CEM II/B-M 42.5 N and CEM II/B-M 32.5 N as products of CIMAF Gabon.

CIMAF's current Guinea-Bissau page states that it established a modern industrial plant in the Dolola industrial zone in 2019, with annual capacity of 350,000 tonnes and identifies it as a grinding plant.
CIMAF's official Guinea-Bissau site information lists CEM II/B-M 32.5R and CEM II/A-M 42.5R among the locally produced cement products.

CIMAF's current Guinea Conakry page states that CIMAF has operated a cement plant in the Kagbelen industrial zone since 2013, expanded in 2020 to 1.5 million tonnes/year, and identifies the site as one grinding plant.
The same current official page identifies CEM III/A 42.5 N cement as produced by CIMAF Guinea Conakry through grinding clinker, blast-furnace slag and gypsum.

name: CIMAF Mali Diago and Sikasso grinding plants

sources.evidence: CIMAF's current Mali page states that operations began in 2016 with the Diago plant, that a second unit opened in Sikasso in 2025, and that the two grinding plants provide a combined capacity of 2 million tonnes/year.
The current official Mali page lists CIMENT SUPER CPJ45 among products and provides contact addresses for the Diago and Sikasso plants.

name: Cimenterie du Sahel Nouakchott grinding plant

sources.evidence: CIMAF's current Mauritania page identifies Cimenterie du Sahel, a subsidiary of CIMAF Mauritania, in the Nouakchott port zone as one grinding plant with 0.5 million tonnes/year capacity.
The current official page lists CEM II/A-M 52.5 N and CEM II 42.5R cement products for the Nouakchott operation.

name: CIMAF Chad Lamadji grinding and packaging plant

sources.evidence: CIMAF's current Chad page states that it has operated in N'Djamena since 2017 through a modern grinding and packaging plant in Lamadji with initial capacity of 500,000 tonnes/year, expandable to 1 million tonnes/year.
The same current official page lists locally produced products including CIMROUTE PRO MAX, Constructor Pro CPJ45, Constructor CPJ35, Constructor Max CEM II 42.5R and Resistor CPJ55.
